title: A phase diagram for training and inference in language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.19848v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A language model is a complex system whose behavior is determined jointly by the Transformer and the corpus, yet how the representation geometry in the Transformer relates to the actual behavior of language models remains open. We analyze how the representation geometry changes along the forward propagation of actual language models and characterize the representation geometry of a document at a given layer by two collective coordinates, document distinguishability and document dimension. On the phase diagram spanned by these collective coordinates, inference is represented as a flow along depth. We find that, for untrained models, depending on their initialization scale, most of the 156 inference flows move toward the collapse and noise regions of the phase diagram. By contrast, the inference flows of 8 trained models from 5 architecture families all enter and reside in the central region of the phase diagram. Describing the evolution

translated_title: 语言模型训练与推理的相图
translated_abstract: 语言模型是一个复杂系统，其行为由Transformer和语料库共同决定，然而Transformer中的表示几何与语言模型实际行为之间的关系仍是未解之谜。我们分析了实际语言模型在前向传播过程中表示几何的变化，并用两个集体坐标——文档可区分性和文档维度——来刻画文档在给定层的表示几何。在这些集体坐标张成的相图上，推理表现为沿深度的流动。我们发现，对于未训练的模型，取决于其初始化尺度，156条推理流中的大多数都朝向相图的坍缩区和噪声区移动。相比之下，来自5个架构家族的8个训练后模型的推理流均进入并驻留在相图的中心区域。
tldr: 本文用文档可区分性和文档维度两个集体坐标构建了语言模型表示几何的相图，发现未训练模型的推理流趋向坍缩或噪声区域，而训练后模型的推理流稳定驻留在相图中心区域。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a phase diagram for representation geometry in language models using two collective coordinates—document distinguishability and document dimension—and finds that inference flows of untrained models drift toward collapse or noise regions, while those of trained models stably reside in the central region of the phase diagram.
